normative_provenance.candidate_terminology_policy: S-C01 candidate terminology is not included and is not normative for this source-stage task.

source_interface.route: normal rendered arXiv Advanced Search UI
source_interface.request_method: GET through the rendered browser page
source_interface.field_boundary: All fields, exactly the visible arXiv all-fields control; no title/abstract/author subfield is substituted.

controlled_vocabulary_supplement.reason: No genuine source-controlled vocabulary or usable indexed-term descriptor is established in the source-free packet. Do not emulate one.

term_rendering.single_lexical_token: source token, preserving dictionary spelling and case

boolean_rendering.grouping: explicit parentheses around every concept block

paired_term_handling.normative_requirement: Unordered pair in one searchable field with no more than five intervening lexical tokens.
paired_term_handling.draft_fallback: BG1, BG2, BC1, and BT2 use a broader conjunctive left-group/right-group expression inside the single visible all-fields route. This cannot lose an exact pair if arXiv applies the all-fields route as one searchable field, but it may retrieve cross-field or distant matches and is not claimed exact.
paired_term_handling.same_field_basis: The source-native field is the single visible all-fields control; the no-loss claim is draft/inferred only until P01.

evidence_window.upper_final: P-001 exact common cutoff, not yet set
evidence_window.pilot_upper_bound: Use the actual P01 execution year as the visible submitted-date upper-year bound and label it pilot-date diagnostic only. It is not P-001 and is not a final publication-date cutoff.
evidence_window.precision: year-granular source control in the current adapter; exact day semantics untested

language.reason: The protocol requires full-text English at screening; English metadata or a source language control would not prove full-text language.

publication_type_access_and_content.source_boundary_note: The arXiv repository boundary makes records preprints, but does not make every record a substantial completed eligible report.

publication_type_and_version_identity.eligibility_rule: Apply the protocol publication-type rule at full text. A repository result, a Preprint label, or a DOI does not establish a substantial completed report, English full text, or peer review.
publication_type_and_version_identity.stable_identity: Use the canonical bare arXiv identifier (for example, 2401.12345) as the source record identity; do not substitute DOI, title, or rank.
publication_type_and_version_identity.version_rule: If the rendered canonical abstract/PDF route explicitly contains vN, preserve that version separately from the bare identifier. If no suffix is rendered, record version as unknown/not exposed; never infer v1.
publication_type_and_version_identity.date_rule: The visible Submitted date and version history are arXiv submission metadata. For screening, use the earliest version containing a substantial completed report as required by the protocol and record every available version/date. Do not relabel a posting/submission date as another source publication date.
publication_type_and_version_identity.companion_rule: Do not merge an arXiv preprint with a formal version during a pilot. Later report-family merging is a full-text identity decision under the protocol and must preserve version-level provenance and substantive differences.

partition_to_cell_unions.role: EPS functions or analyses × all model terms

lossless_union_rule.per_partition: Each partition has one exact UTF-8 cell; its union is the identity set of that cell.
lossless_union_rule.shards: No lossless shards are required by the current adapter safety limit for these draft cells. If the live UI rejects a cell for length, stop and define prospective complete shards; never silently shorten a cell.
lossless_union_rule.failure: A failed, null-total, rewritten, short, stale, duplicate-ID, malformed, or incomplete cell is not a zero and contributes no importable prefix.

generation.generator: Source-free renderer from slr1-search-concepts/v4; exact query files are the normative cells.
generation.term_preservation: Every finite dictionary literal required by each partition is present in its cell; no S-C01 term, wildcard, descriptor, or semantic narrowing was added.
generation.query_file_encoding: UTF-8 with one terminal LF; query text is entered verbatim as the single all-fields term.
generation.live_validation: none; P01 is required before acceptance.
